paras: Cyrtodactylus ziegleri is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Vietnam.
The specific name, ziegleri, is in honor of German herpetologist Thomas Ziegler.
C. ziegleri is found in southern Vietnam, in Dak Lak Province.
The preferred natural habitat of C. ziegleri is forest, at altitudes of 500–2,000 m (1,600–6,600 ft).
Relatively large for its genus, C. ziegleri may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 9.3 cm (3.7 in).
The mode of reproduction of C. ziegleri is unknown.
